title: An out-of-bounds write (OOW) condition in the AMD Compressonator SDK could allow an attacker with local access to…
description: An out-of-bounds write vulnerability exists in the AMD Compressonator SDK that could allow a local attacker to supply a specially crafted DDS file, potentially causing heap corruption or denial of service. The vulnerability requires local access and user interaction. It has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.2. No patch or remediation information is currently available.
